note.label: The Decayed State of Liberal Women

precepts.why:
“A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come”: giving birth you will be in sorrow and feel a lot of pain. “but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world”. For joy a man is born into the world.

Write down Luke 1:13-14: that is when Elisabeth bore John the Baptist, and there was much joy in the world at his birth. The birth of a child is meant to bring joy, not depression. God made the woman “to be a joyful mother of children.”

So sisters should not be having kids and talking about being depressed, or using the liberal word from social media, overstimulated. Overwhelmed can be understood, because when a baby comes you will sometimes be overwhelmed, and that is why it is good to be a family and around each other, so the kids can go by the grandparents. But naturally a woman is not supposed to be like that after she gives birth. Much of the depression during and after pregnancy comes from what Esau gives you: the pills and the prenatal vitamins with folic acid, and food without nutrients. The white man is the devil.

The sisters training as midwives, doulas, doctors and nurses need to bring that lost knowledge back and teach it: the right food after pregnancy, the vitamins from food, the herbs, the steam baths. Postpartum is Leviticus 12, the days of her purification, when a woman was put in a separate place and nursed back to health by her family and the midwives.

precepts.text: It is expedient that Christ go away, for if he does not depart the Comforter will not come; he had to die for the Holy Ghost to be given.
precepts.point: The Holy Ghost comes in an order that begins with the law: turn at his reproof and keep the commandments, and then he pours out his spirit and opens the understanding. Only the Most High can give the wisdom to interpret this book, which is the most purchased yet least understood book on the earth.

note.label: Acts 1: The Promise of the Father and the Kingdom Restored to Israel

precepts.why:
Christ commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem but to “wait for the promise of the Father”, and the promise of the Father is the Holy Ghost, given only after Christ was glorified.

“Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.” He had to die for the Holy Ghost to be given. That is why they had to wait.

precepts.text: The time cometh that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
precepts.point: When men believe the law is done away they hold no morals to restrain them, and will put the teachers to death thinking they do the will of the Most High.

note.label: Acts 5: All Things Common, and We Ought to Obey God Rather Than Men

precepts.why:
Christ warned, “They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.”

The council, cut to the heart, took counsel to slay the apostles, thinking they did the will of the Most High. When men believe the law is done away they hold no morals to restrain them, and will put those who teach the truth to death thinking they do the will of God. It is no different from religious leaders today who take counsel against the truth, publish books against it, and would sooner hire accusers than correct themselves.

precepts.text: Christ warned they would put you out of the synagogues, and the time cometh that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth the Most High a service; brothers and sisters are already being put out of churches for questioning Christianity.
precepts.point: Because of this you have to be as a pilgrim, one that is ready to get up at any moment and abandon everything. They may come to your house to arrest you, and you have to be ready to leave the pretty house, the picket fence, and the comfortable bed at the drop of a dime, the way our fathers were fugitives. Christ warned the disciples this would happen from city to city, and it came to pass, and it is coming again.

note.label: Acts 8: The Word Scattered Abroad, and the Baptism unto the Conscience

precepts.why:
“These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended. They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.” Christ warned it ahead of time so that we would not be offended when it comes.

That is the spirit in Saul, making havoc of the church, and it is the same spirit that will rise up in the religious leaders again. They will seek after us and put us through hell, thinking they do the Most High a service. Brothers and sisters are already being put out of churches for questioning Christianity; it came to pass, and it is coming again.
